title: The Atlas Six
author: Olivie Blake
summary: Six of the most gifted magicians of their generation are recruited by a secret society that guards the lost knowledge of the Library of Alexandria. Only five will be admitted after a year, and all must compete.
readIf: you like morally grey casts, dark academia and magic that is as much theory as spell.
skipIf: you want warmth or a plot-driven story, since it is a talky, ambiguous setup for sequels.

pairings.reason: The model for dark-academia, with clever students and an insular group whose ideals turn deadly.
Another story of brilliant people at a magical school and the unhappiness of their ambition.
A much larger, more playful treatment of academic magic and rivalry.
